why: #42804: the screen action composition adapter verifies the provider against InternalPageTabStore’s private owning DaemonStore and MachineRegistry, and resolves App-only tab panes without weakening daemon-tab ambiguity checks. These are App-owned types; moving this adapter into CmuxNextMacScreen would introduce a dependency from that domain back to the App. The accessor exposes only a checked key, not the owner map.
